image_pattern_summary: Verified good RCC toilet images consistently show a complete single-compartment precast cabin photographed from the front with the door open, revealing the interior floor and commode (typically Indian-style squat pan). Exterior finishes vary widely — painted cream, white, blue, grey, or unpainted concrete — but the rectangular cabin form with a hinged metal door and coloured top band is the dominant visual signature. Products are shown in real installation contexts (rural fields, construction sites, outdoor ground) rather than studio settings, with drainage pipes, septic tank rings, or overhead water tanks sometimes visible as contextual installation details.

reason: RCC toilet cabins are physical structures; product identity is conveyed by form, material finish, door type, and structural configuration, not by printed text on the product surface.
Brand placards visible on some units are incidental marketing material, not product specification data that OCR could usefully extract.
Buyers assess product quality from visual cues (wall thickness, finish quality, door type, interior layout, installation context) rather than text labels on the product.
